title: Live Campaign Measurement
subtitle: Parallel travelers. One verifiable campaign history.
metaDescription: Five fictional travelers follow overlapping paths as their events join one signed blockchain. Inspect records, test edits, and watch individual travelers cycle through.
imageAlt: Illustrative mountain landscape for fictional Cedar Valley Tourism
problem: People respond to campaigns at different times, while measurement records need one auditable history.
task: Show overlapping traveler journeys and an understandable blockchain without grouped or turn-based playback.
actions: Gave five visible traveler lanes independent event timing on one shared simulation clock.
Added a sequential verified block writer and individual traveler replacement after measurement ends.
Kept a compact linked record view, complete history inspection, and editable-copy verification.
results: Traveler observations overlap, while each recorded check appears with its verified block.
Finished travelers leave individually; earlier records remain in the same campaign chain.
notes: Unlisted, browser-local educational blockchain. All people and outcomes are fictional; local signatures do not prove real ad delivery, visitation or independent consensus. Timing and outcome mixes are illustrative.
